doc: Lane gunplay: the weapon range hook. `--weapon=<weapons.json id>` arms Rivet with that table gun on the arena's real fight (GunplayHook: GunHand, FightAreas, GuardTell, HitLink); without it the arena keeps Gloria. The evening draft's range lanes and tuning keys stay in evidence/gunplay/station-draft until they are checked against the merged arena.

stations.doc: Run: arena.tscn -- --weapon=rocket_launcher --bot=pit (the pit's contractors) or --bot=range (the dummies).
stations.name: Weapon range (gunplay)
